scope: Primary non-HLA non-palindromic biallelic autosomal SNV cleaning and coordinate/allele harmonisation only; no replication tests
multi_record_position_policy: exclude all rows at any source position with more than one record, including exact duplicate IDs; no best-P or first-row choice
palindromic_policy: exclude all A/T and C/G pairs, never use cross-ancestry EAF to infer orientation
lift_policy: exactly one total mapping, primary autosome, one base, no chromosome change, unique exact coordinate/strand roundtrip; reject target-position collisions
allele_policy: complement both BBJ alleles only for a negative lift strand; direct or swapped match to FinnGen REF/ALT; flip BETA and EAF only on swap
sample_size_policy: preserve BBJ per-variant N; per-variant cases/controls remain missing when N differs from 212453
